subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Adventurers' Guild in Inazuma City

400200101.text: Hello, Traveler. You couldn't have come at a better time.

400200102.text: The Adventurers' Guild has received a new commission, but it's a little complicated. We've struggled to find the right candidate for the job.

400200103.text: Lay it on me, it's starting to feel like eternity around here.

400200104.text: I'll get straight to the point. The client is a distinctive musician from Liyue.

400200105.text: She's in possession of a temporary travel permit that's about to expire, and is looking for someone familiar with the process to help her renew it and avoid deportation.

400200106.text: Does this really count as adventuring...

400200107.text: Hey, wipe that disappointed look off your face! Imagine if you were in that situation!

400200108.text: Hmm, a distinctive female musician from Liyue... sounds familiar...

400200112.text: Oh? Is she a friend of yours? She headed for the Tenryou Commission after submitting her request, you should be able to find her there.

400200113.text: I hear that the Commission has been very busy recently, so they probably won't be able to help her...

400200114.text: If it's who Paimon thinks it is, she's probably introducing the Tenryou Commission to some sweet riffs right now!

400200115.text: I'm not sure that would end well.

400200116.text: B—But doesn't everyone love rock 'n' roll...? Hmm, we should probably get over there before she gets arrested for public disorder!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

400202001.text: So it is Xinyan! Ha! Paimon's intuition prevails again.

400202002.text: You couldn't even remember her name just now...

400202003.text: Huh? Well, I'll be! Paimon, Traveler, what are you two doing here!?

400202004.text: Never thought I'd run into familiar faces so far from home! If you're here for a performance, I'm afraid I gotta disappoint you.

400202008.text: Have you heard of the Iridescence Tour? It's okay if you haven't... I didn't hear about it until just recently.

400202009.text: The more I think about it, this whole thing was weird from the get-go!

400202032.text: The organizers told me it was a music festival from Fontaine that was famous throughout Teyvat, but it seemed like nobody in Liyue had ever heard of it before.

400202010.text: There was a guy standing on the side of the road calling out, like he was selling Sunsettias or somethin'... I only inquired because I felt bad for him.

400202011.text: Aww, that was nice of you...

400202012.text: Well anyway, he showed me a ton of material — the Iridescence Tour is a big deal over in Fontaine.

400202033.text: I heard that gettin' stage time means your music might start to be heard far and wide.

400202013.text: Wow, you'd be famous overnight if you were up there!

400202014.text: You think so? Me too! I want as many folks as possible to hear my music — that's why I'm so set on attendin' the festival.

400202015.text: This year's Iridescence Tour is bein' held here in Inazuma. I've been honin' a bunch of new songs since I signed up — I even asked Beidou to ferry me out here ahead of time to scout the place out and make sure everythin' goes perfect.

400202016.text: Xiangling made me up a special packed lunch to wish me well! But... the organizers...

400202017.text: They ran into trouble out on the ocean — they can't make it. They even got fishing boats to send a message to Inazuma so the authorities could start spreadin' the word — the Iridescence Tour is canceled!

400202018.text: How can they just cancel it like that? I come here to perform, and they tell me this after I arrive? Now there's no way of getting the travel permit that the organizers arranged for me, and my temporary travel permit here is about to expire. Things couldn't have gone much worse...

400202019.text: Seems like no one was more excited than you about performing at the festival, why should you get the short end of the stick...

400202022.text: *sigh* It ain't always easy being a musician...

400202023.text: Well shucks, enough complainin'. This ain't the first time I wasn't able to perform. Time to move on!

400202024.text: Wow, you sure cheered up quick!

400202025.text: If you wanna play rock 'n' roll for a livin', you gotta be tenacious! That's why I sprang into action. I submitted a request at the Adventurers' Guild and headed straight to the Tenryou Commission to see what else I could find out.

400202026.text: However... I've been standing here for ages already. I'm not sure what's keepin' those Tenryou Commission samurai so busy that they don't even have time to say hi.

400202027.text: How dare they! Paimon bets they're just goofing off!

400202028.text: It's fine, stuff like this is bound to happen when you step onto unfamiliar shores. Hey Traveler, Beidou told me you've been in Inazuma for a while now. You must know how to get things done 'round here, right? Think you can help me out?

400202029.text: Don't sweat it, I'm on the case.

400202030.text: Now we're talkin'! If you can get my permit straightened out, I'll write you a killer tune as a token of my heartfelt gratitude.

subQuests.subQuestName: Negotiate with the officials at the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

400200301.text: Huh? You again? I thought I told you we're busy already! You'll have to wait.

400200302.text: Sorry fellas, perhaps my agent here can explain.

400200304.text: Madam Kujou Sara...? Oh, you must be the Traveler...

400200305.text: Is this outsider girl a friend of yours?

400200306.text: Sure is! She got stood up and now she's stuck here, so she needs to extend her travel permit. Come on, what kind of impression are you guys creating for visitors here, hmm?

400200307.text: Please don't be mistaken, we're not purposely delaying anything. Something big happened recently and the Tenryou Commission is spread thin — we don't have the resources right now.

400200308.text: The reason this young lady is still in the queue isn't because she came later than anyone else, it's because there's no one free to take care of smaller issues like travel permits.

400200310.text: *sigh* I can't tell you any more. Madam Kujou Sara is in the courtyard. Ask her yourself if you want to understand the situation.

400200311.text: Seems like we don't have much choice.

400200313.text: Seems that way! But that's OK, they're just doing their job.

400200401.text: Madam Kujou Sara is in the courtyard, you can try asking her yourself.

400200501.text: Formations! Follow the vanguard and assemble outside the city!

400200502.text: Hmm? Traveler? And who else do we have here?

400200504.text: No harm done. What brings you to the Tenryou Commission headquarters all of a sudden? Is there trouble afoot?

400200505.text: Because if there's anything I can help with, don't hesitate to ask.

400200506.text: Finally, someone who can call the shots!

400200507.text: I see, it's regrettable that your friend has run into such an unfortunate incident, especially after such a journey.

400200508.text: The Tenryou Commission is experiencing a large turnover of personnel in very difficult circumstances. We really are short on people. I apologize for not having tended to your friend's request on time.

400200509.text: It's rare to see you guys struggling like this. What is it this time?

400200512.text: Oh, yeah! We're just... casually asking...

400200513.text: No one's to blame here, seems I just arrived at a bad time.

400200514.text: How about we make a deal?

400200515.text: Yeah! Why don't you tell us what kind of trouble you're facing, and we'll do our best to help? In return, maybe you could help Xinyan extend her travel permit?

400200516.text: ...We really could use the extra help, especially from capable individuals like yourselves...

400200517.text: Alright, here's the situation. Recently, a nameless Domain has appeared in the Araumi region. Monsters with incredible strength have been pouring into the area.

400200518.text: But, surely the Tenryou Commission are used to dealing with monsters?

400200519.text: The Domain appeared quite unexpectedly, and we've come under serious pressure. I've already sent out scouts to investigate.

400200520.text: Originally, I was planning to lead a force there myself... but an extended period on the front lines would leave the Tenryou Commission without oversight... it just didn't feel right.

400200521.text: If you need folks who can fight, I'll wager we can certainly be of assistance! Ain't that right, Traveler?

400200524.text: Yeah! We do you a favor, and you do us a favor. Got it?

400200525.text: Geez, are you really giving orders to a general, Paimon?

400200526.text: Hehe, it's fine, I'm indebted to you. This really is the best solution at the moment.

400200527.text: If it were anyone else, I'd have to refuse... but even the Almighty Shogun has recognized your abilities, Traveler. I'm happy to assign this task to you.

400200528.text: Say now, sounds like you've made quite a name for yourself in Inazuma...

400200530.text: I'm gettin' to! Xiangling and the other folks are always sayin' you're destined for big things...

400200531.text: Madam Kujou Sara, where should we go next?

400200532.text: I'll take you over to the location now. I should warn you that I haven't been there myself yet, so I'm not sure how dangerous things could get...

400200533.text: As a precaution, please bring sufficient combat equipment and supplies with you.

400200534.text: Uh, can we write off the expenses?

400200535.text: Fair enough, I'll put in a request now...

400200536.text: Hold up! I remember there's a travel permit processin' fee, why don't you write that off and I'll cover all our other expenses.

400200538.text: It's nothin', actually Beidou gave me a bag of Mora to spend before I even got off the ship! Seein' as I'm inconveniencin' just about everyone, it's about time I had somethin' to show for it.

400200539.text: Why don't we just split it between us? It should cover equipment and supplies, no trouble.

400200540.text: ...You are a woman of method and integrity, I see.

400200541.text: Aww, don't mention it... but don't go forgettin' about my permit now...

400200542.text: I will see to it personally, you have nothing to worry about.

400200544.text: So it's agreed? Alright, let's take care of this Domain!

400200545.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's hit the road!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go into the domain to investigate

400200702.text: We were ambushed by monsters at the entrance as soon as we started to investigate.

400200703.text: We were able to push most of them back into the Domain, but... some of them escaped to the southeast...

400200704.text: Many of our troops were injured, so I decided to tend to them before issuing the order to pursue. Forgive me!

400200705.text: Southeast? Oh no, there'll be civilians along the way...

400200716.text: This is urgent, we need to split up for now. I'll lead a team to pursue the monsters that got away. The situation here I leave in your hands.

400200706.text: I'm sure you don't need reminding... but be careful.

400200709.text: Don't worry about a thing, we got this!

400200710.text: Uhh... one more thing! Monsters often try to sneak out from the Domain. Keep a close watch on the entrance and don't let any of them past, or else—

400200715.text: Well, she is leading an army after all!

400200717.text: Okay, let's get over to the entrance!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the domain and guard the gate

400201101.text: It's just... a piece of paper?

400201102.text: It looks like a little paper figure. Is it a talisman? Maybe one of the samurai dropped it.

400201103.text: A paper figure, huh... reminds me of the shikigami they talk about in the legends.

400201105.text: Yeah. I spend a lotta time looking into legends from all over Teyvat — they give me inspiration for my lyrics.

400201106.text: They say in Inazuma there are paper cut-outs imbued with magical power that follow their masters wherever they go. Some of them can banish evil, repel monsters, or even protect your home.

400201107.text: Sounds a bit like all that sigil and adepti art stuff they have over in Liyue...

400201109.text: What!? Paimon is a professional Teyvat travel guide AND your best friend! Let's see your fighting origami do that!

400201110.text: Wait! Look! The shikigami... It's... it's movin'!

400201111.text: Hey there, lil' paper guy! Can you hear us? Can you talk?

400201112.text: Where am I...? Ah! Did I faint?

400201113.text: Oh no... I'm... Wait! Did you see the monsters that escaped from here? Where did they go?

400201114.text: There were monsters around here alright, but we took care of all of 'em.

400201115.text: Phew... Thank you. And thank goodness they didn't manage to escape... I'd never forgive myself if someone got hurt...

400201116.text: Are you a shikigami? Those monsters... you didn't let them out, right?

400201117.text: To my knowledge, shikigami are all about defeating monsters... so what's your story?

400201119.text: My name is Shiki Taishou, and I'm sorry you have to see me like this on our first meeting.

400201120.text: This Domain is called the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. I'm the overseer in charge here.

400201121.text: The Mystic Onmyou Chamber has been in an extended slumber, just as I have. However, a few days ago, under the influence of an unknown power, all the monsters in the Domain were suddenly awakened... and the door was opened...

400201122.text: Actually... it seems like I may have suffered some memory loss in the process. All I remember is waking up to a living nightmare... I tried my best to stop them.

400201123.text: I was surprised to see the monsters turn into paper charms when they were defeated. That's when I remembered that they must also be onmyoudou creations... and form part of this onmyou chamber, like me.

400201125.text: I'm sorry... I can't give you a clear explanation right now...

400201127.text: Me...? M—My sincere apologies! I am a shikigami, but all I know is that I'm the overseer responsible for this Domain. I can't remember who my master is, or why I was created in the first place. *sigh* I'm a failure...

400201129.text: You mean, you don't even know if you're one of the good guys?

400201130.text: Hey, don't worry! Paimon heard that those with memory loss sometimes start to remember things when they return to a familiar place. Why don't you try going back into the Domain?

400201131.text: I was just about to try that.

400201132.text: I still have many unanswered questions, but one thing I'm certain of is that my powers originate from this Domain... We might even be one and the same.

400201133.text: For some reason... I have a feeling that I should be able to completely control it!

400201134.text: If shikigami are supposed to help with banishing evil and repelling monsters, you were probably stationed here to guard the entrance!

400201135.text: As for your memory loss, did you ever hear those stories? Y'know, the ones where someone loses their memory and forgets about the incredible powers they had. Once they remember, they become invincible again!

400201136.text: Actually, I was just thinking along those lines... Do you think you all can help me out?

400201137.text: The most urgent task is helping you to remember, right? Once your memory's back, you might be able to control the Domain again, and stop any more monsters from escaping.

400201138.text: Traveler, can I borrow you for a second?

400201139.text: This Shiki Taishou has only just woken up, and it's lost part of its memory... Do you trust it?

400201141.text: If it really is a guardian of the Domain, then we're in good company... but if it's not...

400201301.text: Strange... the Mystic Onmyou Chamber doesn't look special in any way.

400201302.text: True, but I can sense my power regenerating... Whew, I feel much better now.

400201303.text: Wait! Look over there! Is there... someone here already?

400201304.text: Someone inside the Domain? I... I can't believe it. Who would choose to enter a Domain like this one...?

400201306.text: Oh? I was wondering who it could be, but it seems you—

400201308.text: I heard your footsteps and thought: Who in Teyvat would set foot in such a dangerous Domain...?

400201310.text: Then I heard your voice and well... Haha, it all made sense.

400201311.text: It's been a long time, Traveler. You're getting bolder.

400201312.text: Childe! What are you doing here?

400201313.text: The Domain, wait... Are you responsible for all this!?

400201314.text: "Child?" He's on the tall side isn't he?

400201317.text: Hello miss, Tartaglia will do just fine, I'm—

400201318.text: Paimon'll tell you who he is! He's someone who shows up before bad things happen!

400201319.text: Hey now, all this time apart and this is the greeting I get?

400201320.text: Y—You know what Paimon's talking about!

400201321.text: (Wait, Xinyan doesn't know what Paimon's talking about...! And knowing Xinyan, if she found out about Childe's actions in Liyue... Oh boy...)

400201322.text: (Hmm, interesting attire, but I think she's a Liyue girl... Now then, perhaps I should just be upfront...?)

400201324.text: Actually, I want to start by—

400201325.text: This is an adventurer we befriended in Mondstadt! Childe is just a nickname we gave him!

400201328.text: T—Tartaglia here is allllways messing stuff up! Even when the dangers are obvious, he just recklessly charges in — something an adventurer should NEVER do! So we get a lil' annoyed with him sometimes, hehe...

400201329.text: ...Uhh... Yes! Yes, yes — I couldn't have put it better myself. I too am an adventurer, and I've caused my fair share of trouble for Paimon and the Traveler here, for which I'm... unfathomably sorry.

400201331.text: Oh, so you're a Mondstadter! Pleasure to meet ya, I'm from Liyue myself. The name's Xinyan, and the name of the game is rock 'n' roll!

400201332.text: The pleasure's all mine. So, are you here to explore the Domain too?

400201333.text: That's right, we're trying to find out why the monsters here are so active.

400201372.text: According to Shiki Taishou here, this Domain is known as the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. There are lots of dangerous monsters inside that were created using onmyoudou.

400201334.text: A Domain that lets its monsters escape in the outside world... What forces are at play here?

400201335.text: As for me, I stumbled in almost by accident, but now I'm curious about this mystery. We adventurers don't rest until the truth comes to light — it's in our nature. So, do you mind if I join you guys? I can offer my aid in return.

400201336.text: If you haven't heard, I'm pretty handy in a fight...

400201339.text: You're not going to reject me, are you? Oh, don't be so cruel, Traveler — you know how strong I am!

400201342.text: Another addition to the Shiki Taishou memory huntin' crew! There's strength in numbers, haha.

400201343.text: I'm assuming Shiki Taishou is the little paper fellow here, right?

400201344.text: Hmm... A simple yet captivating design, and look at the little face! I bet my brother would love one.

400201347.text: Ahem, alright, why don't I bring our new companion up to speed?

400201348.text: You said that you're the overseer here... but I didn't see you when I entered. That must mean you were already unconscious by the time I arrived, correct?

400201350.text: Well brother, maybe if you'd slowed down a little bit you would have noticed.

400201351.text: Brother? Haha, that's a very intimate way of addressing someone — I like it! You remind me of my little sister...

400201352.text: So, according to the information we have, it's very possible that Shiki Taishou is the guardian of this Domain.

400201353.text: I'm sure we'll find out the truth of that soon enough. Shiki Taishou also says that its power has been regenerating ever since it set foot here. It might even be able to absorb more power the further in we go.

400201354.text: Shiki Taishou, can you remember anythin' yet? Or, do you feel different in any way?

400201355.text: They say that everything about shikigami is derived from magic... perhaps the more powerful our friend here becomes, the more likely it is that they'll recover their memories.

400201356.text: Now that I've been here a little while, I have a vague sense that I should be able to control certain parts of this Domain... Overseers are supposed to have that ability.

400201357.text: I've taken care of the monsters in this room. They all turned into tattered paper charms when I defeated them.

400201358.text: *sigh* That was some exhilarating combat, but I'm afraid I can't seem to find a way to progress further. Shiki Taishou, as our resident overseer, do you have any tricks up your sleeve?

400201359.text: Allow me to give it a try... Haa!

400201360.text: What in tarnation? The door opened!

400201361.text: Uhh... anyone else getting the creeps here? It looks real eerie. Someone else go in front! Childe, how about you?

400201363.text: It's the scent of monsters... the aroma of battle.

400201364.text: The monsters here are strong, fierce fighting awaits us... but I wouldn't have it any other way. You guys should learn to see the fun side of combat.

400201365.text: I don't care how strong they are, they'll be ashes when I'm finished with them!

400201366.text: M—Make sure you guys protect us! Especially Paimon...

400201369.text: This place... Yes, this used to be my dominion! I should be able to do more than just open doors and activate mechanisms here.

400201370.text: Fight... I—I should know how to fight!

400201371.text: Everyone! I've just remembered some combat techniques. Please, allow me to assist you in battle with shikifuda and onmyoudou.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go deeper into The Ominous Demesne

400201401.text: We must tend to the wounded quickly and consolidate our position...

400201402.text: The Tenryou Commission must not falter, no matter the odds!

400201403.text: Even if the situation's looking grim, he's still super focused. Seems like a dedicated samurai to Paimon.

400202101.text: Not bad, that was some perilous action... I've experienced close calls like that before.

400202102.text: No surprise to see Childe enjoying himself. Do you really enjoy fighting that much?

400202103.text: Of course! I relish this kind of endless fighting. Putting your life on the line, giving your all, and leaving nothing on the battlefield...

400202104.text: Hmm... I guess bringing Childe along does have its advantages. We're making quick work of these monsters!

400202105.text: Hey! Watch your step! What is that?

400202106.text: This paper cut-out looks just like Shiki Taishou!

400202107.text: I know what this is. It's a replica of me — a mass-produced shikigami based on my design. It has my power... and possibly a portion of my memories...

400201601.text: How was it? What did you see?

400201605.text: He was the first onmyouji of Inazuma and a master of charm magic. He created me and this Domain, and lived here in seclusion for a very long time.

400201606.text: Huh, so it was your master that created this place.

400201607.text: But what was his reason behind creatin' you and the Domain?

400201608.text: I'm sorry... I'm not sure of that myself just yet.

400201609.text: Perhaps he was passionate about onmyoudou? Maybe when he discovered how strong he was, he decided to create a place like this to hone his abilities, to become even stronger...

400201610.text: It's possible. Those obsessed with certain disciplines are often capable of incredible feats.

400201611.text: Perhaps that was the case with Kamuna Harunosuke. Onmyoudou may have been everything to him, so he created a Domain to train in.

400201612.text: But, he couldn't foresee that something would go wrong with the Domain, that he would lose control of the onmyoudou, and that his shikigami would turn into monsters.

400201613.text: Wah! Shikigami can turn into monsters!?

400201614.text: Th—That's not possible, right!? That could be bad news for us!

400201615.text: I'm just shooting in the dark here. If the monsters weren't originating from the shikigami or paper charms, where were they coming from? The Inazuman authorities must have caught wind of this place and sent people here to seal it off, sending Shiki Taishou into a deep sleep in the process...

400201616.text: No. Even though I still can't recall what he looked like, or how it felt to be in his company, there is one thing I'm certain of...

400201617.text: With his ability, there's no way Kamuna would have made an error like this with his onmyoudou. More importantly, I'm sure he wouldn't have been so irresponsible.

400201618.text: Oh really? Well then, that leaves us with the worst assumption of all.

400201619.text: What if Kamuna Harunosuke is evil, and created this Domain to enhance his onmyoudou? What if he succeeded in creating monsters that could become weapons...?

400201620.text: That would make him a problem, and you... you would be his accomplice.

400201621.text: Evil? Accomplice? Using monsters... as weapons?

400201622.text: Easy red, isn't it a little early to be jumping to conclusions?

400201623.text: Shiki Taishou passed my test and earned my trust. I don't like the way you're talkin'.

400201624.text: Hey, I'm merely making inferences based on Shiki Taishou's memories. I'm not trying to cast doubt on him, and it's true that we don't have any decisive evidence. But we do need to understand the situation here.

400201625.text: Besides... is being used as a weapon really that bad?

400201630.text: Alright, the next room should be through that door.

400201631.text: Let's see if we can find more of Shiki Taishou's replicas and help him restore his memories.

400201632.text: Who knows? We may even find Kamuna Harunosuke himself somewhere further in. I wonder how strong of a fighter he is... I'd like to go a few rounds with him.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go deeper into The Ominous Demesne

400201801.text: I still have to go and check the left corridor after finishing my post...

400201802.text: If only we had more help...

400201803.text: That guy looks busy, let's not disturb him.

400201701.text: Huh? How did we get back out here?

400201702.text: Wasn't that door meant to take us to the next room?

400201703.text: Uh-oh, where's Shiki Taishou and Red? Are they still in the Domain?

400201704.text: Oh no... we can't get back in. It's stoppin' outsiders from enterin'.

400201706.text: What's that rumbling... Can you feel it? Maybe some kind of mechanism has activated inside?

400201708.text: We can't make any hasty decisions... Traveler, Paimon, let's just wait it out for a minute.

400201710.text: Huh!? Kujou Sara? You're back so soon!

400201713.text: Not soon enough, we spent a long time chasing those monsters down. They were cunning, and surprisingly good at evading us.

400201716.text: No other monsters have emerged since we defeated the ones at the entrance.

400201717.text: However, strange noises keep comin' from inside the Domain. Something big must be happenin', but we reckon it might be too dangerous to enter. We're waitin' for the noises to stop before goin' in to investigate.

400201718.text: Hmm... I can sense a power is resisting us.

400201719.text: We've already expended a lot of strength intercepting those monsters, investigating the truth of this Domain would be difficult... We need to be fully prepared.

400201720.text: Ma'am! It's not looking good for the wounded soldiers, but we came across a few scattered monsters on the way back...

400201721.text: If I may be so bold... we need you to bring up the rear and escort the wounded back to the city!
